BehaviorTree._description: 2F-85 calibration entry point. It checks the replacement scene D415 and wrist Orbbec color and depth feeds, then runs the Orbbec eye-in-hand solve. Before starting, save at least five safe wrist waypoints named with the `Orbecc Wall` prefix and rotational diversity about multiple axes. This Objective writes the wrist solve, mount, and shelf-board candidates only. Inspect residuals and the board-pose difference from wall_board before applying any candidate. Run Calibrate Scene Camera From Shelf Board separately after reviewing and applying the shelf-board candidate and saving scene_camera_shelf_clear. Verify camera topics, frame IDs, and the Orbbec cloud before use. See design_docs/orbbec_shelf_board_calibration.md.

SubTree.ID: Calibrate Wrist Orbbec On Shelf Board

Action.message: Wrist calibration candidates are ready. Review used views, residuals and the board-pose difference before applying. Apply the reviewed shelf-board candidate before running Calibrate Scene Camera From Shelf Board; save scene_camera_shelf_clear first.
